articles.title: India Operationalizes National AI Security and Ethics Framework
articles.summary: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology releases comprehensive guidelines for responsible AI deployment and algorithmic auditing.
prelims: Establishment of the IndiaAI Governance Office under MeitY to enforce ethical compliance.
Mandatory algorithmic impact assessments for high-risk public sector AI deployments.
Alignment with the UN Global Digital Compact and OECD Principles on Artificial Intelligence.
articles.mains: Examine the regulatory challenges of balancing Artificial Intelligence innovation with citizen privacy and ethical governance in India.

articles.title: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) Notifies Carbon Credit Trading Scheme Targets
articles.summary: India's domestic carbon market reaches a key operational milestone with emission intensity reduction targets notified for energy-intensive sectors.
prelims: CCTS established under the provisions of the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act, 2022.
National Steering Committee for Indian Carbon Market (NSCICM) serves as the apex governing body.
BEE acts as the administrator, while Grid Controller of India Limited is the registry.
articles.mains: Discuss the role of the Indian Carbon Market in achieving India's Panchamrit climate targets and facilitating a just energy transition.

articles.title: ISRO Completes Payload Integration Tests for Chandrayaan-4 Mission
articles.summary: ISRO successfully completes key module integration tests for the upcoming Chandrayaan-4 mission aimed at lunar sample return.
prelims: Chandrayaan-4 employs a multi-module architecture comprising Transfer, Lander, Ascender, and Re-entry modules.
First Indian space mission designed to perform autonomous lunar orbit docking and sample transfer.
Targeted to land in the lunar south pole region to retrieve volatile and water-ice samples.
articles.mains: Analyze how India's space exploration strategy has evolved from technology demonstration to deep-space resource analysis and international scientific leadership.

articles.title: Progress Review of the National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission
articles.summary: Ministry of Health reports significant milestones in screening and genetic counseling across high-prevalence tribal districts.
prelims: Mission objective: Eliminate Sickle Cell Disease (SCD) as a public health problem in India by 2047.
Focuses on 17 high-priority states covering 278 districts with significant tribal populations.
Utilizes point-of-care rapid diagnostic kits integrated with Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) IDs.
articles.mains: Evaluate the socio-economic impact of genetic blood disorders on tribal communities in India and assess the key pillars of the National Sickle Cell Elimination Mission.

articles.title: NDMA Issues Guidelines on 'Sponge Cities' for Urban Flood Mitigation
articles.summary: National Disaster Management Authority releases updated directives emphasizing nature-based solutions and permeable infrastructure for major urban centers.
prelims: Mandates 'Sponge City' elements: permeable pavements, urban wetlands, rain gardens, and bioswales.
Integration of Doppler Weather Radars (DWR) with real-time municipal drainage monitoring systems.
Aligned with Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction and CDRI urban resilience guidelines.
articles.mains: Urban flooding is increasingly recognized as a policy-driven and planning failure rather than a purely natural hazard. Critically analyze the structural and non-structural measures needed to build resilient Indian cities.
